proposal.hypothesis: One SIMD group per row with coalesced half4 loads and register reuse eliminates all threadgroup barriers and distinct shared max/sum scratch synchronization, reducing latency for 256x1024 while keeping FP32 simd reductions.

Distinct sMax and sSum threadgroup buffers prevent a fast SIMD group from overwriting the broadcast row maximum before other groups read it, fixing repeated-execution nondeterminism while retaining one-pass half4 loads, FP32 register reuse of exponentials, and vectorized output.
